loop.top3_why: The median combination (pool_full) shows the best validation score and, more importantly, the most stable per‑window performance (0.6800, 0.6438, 0.6707). With an unstable model ranking (Kendall tau –0.115) and correlated errors among many models, a robust estimator like the median is likely to generalize better than a mean or a weighted scheme that may overfit to the limited validation windows. The median’s low variance across windows and its deterministic nature make it the safest choice for this series.
loop.top3_why_not: Candidate B (plain mean) has a higher per‑window variance and a slightly worse overall score; its performance is more sensitive to ranking instability. Candidate C (weighted) relies on a meta‑model trained on other series, which introduces high‑variance weight estimates given only three validation windows; its per‑window errors are also more erratic. Both are therefore less robust than the median for this series’ profile.
